propositions.title: Affordable homes
propositions.ifYes: California could borrow money to build affordable homes and help veterans buy homes.
propositions.ifNo: This measure would not provide new housing bond money.

propositions.title: Save for a tough year
propositions.ifYes: California would save more during good years and keep paying down old debts for longer.
propositions.ifNo: California would keep its current savings and debt-payment rules.

propositions.title: Keep the tax on top earners
propositions.ifYes: The extra income tax on top earners would keep going after 2030.
propositions.ifNo: The extra income tax on top earners would still end in 2031.

propositions.title: Public money for campaigns
propositions.ifYes: State and local governments could choose to help fund election campaigns.
propositions.ifNo: This measure would not open up new public campaign funding programs.

propositions.title: Choosing a replacement after a recall
propositions.ifYes: A recall ballot would ask whether to remove the official. A replacement would be chosen later.
propositions.ifNo: Voters would keep choosing a replacement on the recall ballot.

propositions.title: Help buying a new home
propositions.ifYes: A new state loan program would help qualifying families buy newly built homes.
propositions.ifNo: This new homebuyer loan program would not start.

propositions.title: Research to fight disease
propositions.ifYes: California could borrow money for research into how the body fights disease.
propositions.ifNo: This measure would not provide the new research bond money.

propositions.title: Show ID when you vote
propositions.ifYes: Voters would need to provide government ID information when voting.
propositions.ifNo: California would keep its current voting ID rules.

propositions.title: The billionaire tax
propositions.ifYes: Billionaires would owe a one-time 5% tax, mostly to fund health care.
propositions.ifNo: The proposed one-time billionaire tax would not take effect.

propositions.title: New tax audits and spending rules
propositions.ifYes: Some new taxes would face extra audits and state spending limits.
propositions.ifNo: This measure would not add the new tax audits and spending rules.

propositions.title: Limits on new wealth taxes
propositions.ifYes: California could not add certain new taxes just for owning stocks, investments, or other property. It would also limit taxes that reach into the past.
propositions.ifNo: This measure would not add the new restrictions on wealth taxes.

propositions.title: A higher bar for some local taxes
propositions.ifYes: Some local taxes proposed by voters would need two-thirds approval.
propositions.ifNo: Some voter-proposed local taxes could still pass with a simple majority.

propositions.title: A spending rule for health clinics
propositions.ifYes: Covered community clinics would have to spend at least 90% of their money on patient care and related services.
propositions.ifNo: Clinics would not face this new 90% spending rule.

propositions.title: Faster reviews for building projects
propositions.ifYes: Some projects could use faster environmental reviews and shorter court deadlines.
propositions.ifNo: This measure would not add the faster environmental review process.
